versions.changelog: Add skill-card.md; fix security (remove hardcoded dynamic import)

- Initial release of Happy Brushing Hero skill!
- Fun 2-minute brushing timer, encouragement and stories from "小白" the rabbit
- Daily tracking, star ratings, and streak/milestone reminders for kids
- Collect random stickers on each successful brushing; weekly completion tips for parents
- Integrated TTS support to deliver 小白’s messages out loud
- Simple Python scripts, data stored under `~/.bookshelf-plus/kids/`, no third-party dependencies
